It contains more than 5,000 Chinese main-text characters, 24 academic/research references and 27 first-party/platform/community references, and synthesizes AO3 retrieval, tags, bookmarks, collections, social curation, adjacent archives, preservation, Atom feeds, and local reading. Community threads are used as qualitative examples rather than population statistics; platform/policy/interface claims are grounded in first-party sources.

The guide's original synthesis is a `双轴查询 + 五层发现 + 三种时间语义` framework: content semantics and reading cost are separated; discovery proceeds through archive retrieval, second-order curation, author/reader networks, cross-archive supplementation, and a personal local library; new-work time, chapter-update time, and taxonomy/policy time are treated separately.

### Sources

The source cycle both resolved yesterday's AO3 defer and expanded adjacent-archive coverage. Refreshed first-party AO3 evidence supports admitting AO3 Work Search as a bounded first-party discovery route. AO3's official subscriptions/feeds documentation also establishes canonical-tag Atom feeds as a real syndication surface, while the official OTW-Archive repository states that there is currently no general API. WebNR therefore admits AO3 discovery now but does not claim live Atom synchronization before transport, identity, response bounds, update semantics, retry behavior, and versioned fixtures are implemented and tested.

Five new adjacent archive families were screened beyond the prior starter set: SquidgeWorld, fanfiction.lol, Sunset, Ad Astra, and CFAA. SquidgeWorld Work Search, fanfiction.lol Fandom Browse, and Sunset received complete bounded audits and were admitted as first-party link-only routes. Ad Astra's current primary site and CFAA presented Anubis anti-bot challenges in the operating environment; no bypass was attempted, so those richer/current-primary integrations remain deferred rather than being labeled failed or safe by assumption.

The maintained FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, and Scribble Hub discovery routes were rechecked. The resulting `Fanfiction Discovery Starter` now contains seven audited first-party routes: FanFiction.Net, Fimfiction, Scribble Hub, AO3, SquidgeWorld, fanfiction.lol, and Sunset. It stores origin URLs plus WebNR-authored labels/descriptions only; no origin works, story metadata, covers, ratings, comments, bookmarks, account state, downloads, or story text are copied.

Fimfiction's official API and AO3 canonical-tag Atom are the highest-priority richer machine-interface candidates. Link-only is the currently proven capability level, not a permanent ceiling; a richer adapter requires source-specific rights/access, robots, provenance, stable identity, paging/feed behavior, cadence/rate limits, size/timeout, update/deletion semantics, attribution/account boundaries, and versioned fixtures.

The daily source target was therefore met: at least five candidates screened, at least three fully audited, at least one passing integration shipped, and maintained-source health rotated.
